guidanceContent.content: This test config exercises the Apple design quality uplift changes.
Each step tests a specific feature. Use the interactive script to verify.
This step should have slid in from the RIGHT (forward direction).
Click the back button overlay (top-left chevron) to go backward. The content should slide RIGHT (backward direction) and the previous step should slide in from the LEFT.
Then click Continue to come back here and verify forward transition again.
The back button should be a floating circular chevron at the TOP-LEFT of this content panel.
It should NOT appear in the footer bar (bottom)
It should be 18pt from the left edge, 12pt from the top
It should have a circular quaternary background
The footer bar should only show: footer text, step counter, and Continue button.

This paragraph tests the 420pt max-width constraint. The text should NOT stretch across the full width of the content panel. Instead, it should be constrained to a comfortable reading width of approximately 420 points, centered within the panel. There should be visible breathing room on both sides of the text column.

guidanceContent.label: Display brightness
guidanceContent.helpText: Adjusts the display brightness level. Lower values save battery.

guidanceContent.content: Click sidebar items to test direction-aware transitions via sidebar navigation.
Click 'Transitions' (step 2) in the sidebar. Content should slide RIGHT (backward).
Then click 'Sidebar Nav' (this step) in the sidebar. Content should slide LEFT (forward).
The transition direction should always match the navigation direction: clicking a step BEFORE the current one slides backward, clicking AFTER slides forward.
This step has enough content to require scrolling. The scroll hint overlay should appear at the bottom when content overflows.
Section 1: The content panel uses a ScrollView with vertical scrolling. When content exceeds the visible area, a subtle gradient hint appears at the bottom to indicate more content below.
The scroll hint should fade away as you scroll down toward the bottom of the content.

Section 2: The 420pt width constraint ensures that even long paragraphs remain readable. Without this constraint, text lines would stretch across the full 640pt content panel, making them harder to read. The ideal line length for body text is 65-75 characters.
Section 3: This highlight block should also respect the 420pt width constraint and be centered within the panel.
Section 4: Additional content to ensure scrolling is needed. The spring animation on step transitions should still feel smooth even when the content requires scrolling.
Section 5: Warning blocks should also be properly constrained and centered.
